title: NeoHand achieves robotic touch breakthrough with 25 degrees of #OneX #roboticbreakthrough #robotics
description: One X developed the tendon-based NeoHand, the most advanced robot hand to date with 25 degrees of freedom, mimicking the dexterity and strength of a human hand. NeoHand’s breakthrough lies in its ability to feel through force-controlled, fully backdrivable fingers, allowing precise interaction and response to touch. Unlike previous robotic hands that rely solely on cameras for movement estimation, NeoHand’s tactile feedback provides unprecedented control, enabling tasks from assembling Legos to screwing in light bulbs with human-like delicacy. This innovation marks a significant leap in robotics, potentially redefining automation and human-robot interaction. By achieving near-human dexterity and sensory feedback, NeoHand opens new possibilities in manufacturing, healthcare, and service robotics, where sensitive manipulation and adaptability are critical. This technology sets a new benchmark that could accelerate the evolution of robotic applications across industries. #NeoHand #OneX #robotichand #roboticsinnovation #automation #dexterity #robotics #AIrobotics #tactilefeedback #humanoidrobotics #roboticsengineering #roboticsbreakthrough #robottechnology #automationtechnology #roboticsresearch
